subject: pattern/world-model-loop/stale-conditional-note
claim: A world-model loop's fixed-path conditional note is never reset between runs: `notes/deviations.md` is ordered by the execute prompt (workflows/repository/world_model_loop.yaml:75-76) and read by the posterior prompt (:99), but a run with no deviations omits the file, leaving the previous task's document in the slot the posterior is instructed to trust. Measured on the 2026-09-21 run: the execute report says 'No deviations occurred' (commit 6985163dd, one file) yet the deviations file present is the Item-4 document from commit 3689fb233, and notes/posterior.md was likewise the Item-4 posterior (commit 077ad4837) until this run overwrote it — two stale fixed-path notes inherited by one posterior.
